full_judgment: 43. Mr Syed Ishtiaq Ahmed has submitted with reference to section 114(e) of the Evidence Act that there is a presumption that judicial and official acts have been regularly performed. There is no doubt about this legal position, but when an action is taken or decision is taken by maintaining a file that file must be produced to show that the act was done properly. In the instant case, the relevant file has been withheld. So, we are of the view that in this case presumption under section 114(g) of the Evidence Act shall apply. In spite of our repeated orders, the file was not produced by the relevant respondents with whom those were lying. We are very much shocked that the file was withheld and as such constrained to apply the presumption under section 114(g) of the Evidence Act.
